(RS_AP_00128)
This error means that the
application
tried to store data that exceeds the
configured quota of a
storage
. The
application
has to be able to deal
with this situation, and either write less data to the affected
storage
or re-
move outdated data from this
storage
, or reset the affected
element

ara::per::ResetKeyValueStorage
,
ara::per::ResetAll-
Files
,
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::ResetKey
,
ara::per::FileStor-
age::ResetFile
, or even
ara::per::ResetPersistency
.
